# Themed Cloudscape Components

A themed component library built on top of AWS Cloudscape Design System with custom RiskSmart branding. This package provides themed Cloudscape components and shared design tokens compatible with both Cloudscape and Tailwind CSS.

## Overview

This project generates themed Cloudscape components using a shared configuration that defines:

- Custom color palette (navy, teal, grey variations, etc.)
- Typography (Sora font family)
- Design tokens mapped to Cloudscape theming system

## Structure

- `base.config.ts` - Base theme configuration shared between Tailwind and Cloudscape
- `theme.config.ts` - Cloudscape-specific theme configuration and component build script
- `index.ts` - Main entry point exporting the base configuration
- `risksmart-themed/` - Generated themed Cloudscape components

## Development

### Prerequisites

- Node.js
- pnpm

### Build

Generate themed components:

```bash
pnpm build
```

This runs the theme configuration script which builds the themed Cloudscape components into the `risksmart-themed/` directory.

## Publishing a New Version

Create a release and new tag via the GitHub UI to trigger the `Publish Packages` work

## Installing the package

The package is published to a private GitHub package registry. Run:

```
npm config set '//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken' "YOUR_TOKEN!!"
```

with a GitHub auth token with the read:packages permission. https://github.com/settings/tokens
